description: This file defines FastAPI API endpoints related to court management within a pickleball court booking system. It includes CRUD operations, with some endpoints accessible publicly and others restricted to admin users. The endpoints interact with the database layer and utilize schema definitions for request and response data.

methods.name: list[CourtPublic] list_courts(active_only: bool = Query(True, description="Only return active courts"))
methods.description: Endpoint to list all available courts, optionally filtering only active courts.

methods.name: CourtPublic get_court(court_id: int = Path(..., description="Court identifier"))
methods.description: Retrieve details for a specific court by its ID.

methods.name: CourtPublic create_court(payload: CourtCreate, _: UserPublic = Depends(require_admin))
methods.description: Create a new court in the system; restricted to admin users.

methods.name: CourtPublic update_court( payload: CourtUpdate, _: UserPublic = Depends(require_admin), court_id: int = Path(..., description="Court identifier"), )
methods.description: Update an existing court identified by its ID; restricted to admin users.

methods.name: None delete_court( _: UserPublic = Depends(require_admin), court_id: int = Path(..., description="Court identifier"), )
methods.description: Delete a court identified by its ID; restricted to admin users.

ctags.name: delete_court
ctags.signature: ( _: UserPublic = Depends(require_admin), court_id: int = Path(..., description="Court identifier"), )

ctags.name: get_court
ctags.pattern: /^def get_court(court_id: int = Path(..., description="Court identifier")) -> CourtPublic:$/

ctags.name: list_courts
ctags.pattern: /^def list_courts(active_only: bool = Query(True, description="Only return active courts")) -> lis/
ctags.signature: (active_only: bool = Query(True, description="Only return active courts"))

ctags.name: update_court
ctags.signature: ( payload: CourtUpdate, _: UserPublic = Depends(require_admin), court_id: int = Path(..., description="Court identifier"), )
